exposure: obliteration of the hypoechogenic space between the uterus and the placenta
interruption of the hyperechogenic interface between the uterine serosa and the bladder wall
outcome: Diagnostic performance of ultrasound for PAS
cohort: 473 pregnant women with low-lying placenta or placenta previa
finding: Grayscale ultrasound has good diagnostic performance to identify pregnancies at low risk of PAS in women with low-lying placenta or placenta previa.
